agent.name: Claude Code
agent.how: one sibling container (rwe-b1-agentic-scientist-agent:df83138) per agent session, started by the orchestrator

network.search: Provider server-side web search is switched off in every sibling by the agent CLIs' own system settings, bind-mounted read-only by the docker shim: Claude Code /etc/claude-code/managed-settings.json (permissions.deny WebSearch), Codex /etc/codex/config.toml (web_search="disabled") and /etc/codex/requirements.toml (allowed_web_search_modes=["disabled"]). Upstream's own Semantic Scholar client goes through the shield.
network.web_access: Sibling agent containers run on the shield's internal network; the agents keep their CLI WebFetch/Bash network, which go through the shield. Provider hosts are only tunnelled by the shield.

tools.permissions: upstream's own agent settings; provider web search denied by managed settings (Claude Code permissions.deny WebSearch, Codex web_search="disabled")

preinstalled.zh: 编排镜像：上游代码（固定提交、未改）、uv 锁定依赖、docker CLI（经 shim 给兄弟容器加代理和 CA）；agent 镜像：上游自己的 agent-cli Dockerfile
preinstalled.en: orchestrator image: upstream code at the pin (unmodified), uv-locked dependencies, the docker CLI (a shim adds proxy and CA to sibling containers); agent image: upstream's own agent-cli Dockerfile

notes.benchmark_paths: A benchmark item's paths are mounted into the agent containers unless upstream mounts the same path itself (/workspace and below, /home/agent-home, /task-source, /run, /tmp): those are left out and listed in logs/sibling-mounts.txt. The agents work in upstream's own /workspace (the run directory), so a deliverable the official prompt names under such a path is not written where the run collects it.
notes.venue: paper.paper_format=iclr for every task. The system has only iclr and alife specs and does not choose a venue itself; ICML and NeurIPS templates and a system-chosen venue are unsupported.
notes.task_input: Only the `# Goal` and `# Rubrics` sections of task.md are read: all five candidate files are put under `# Goal` with their headings turned into bold lines; `# Rubrics` carries a neutral line. The paradigm is optimisation of a scalar score: the task-drafting phase (documented as experimental) turns the brief into an evaluator and a seed program.
notes.phases: execution.phases=task_drafting,investigation,final_evaluation,paper; the system's own default also runs ablations and posthoc; final_evaluation stays because a drafted task requires it before the paper. review/revision (second model) are never selected.
notes.agent_pool: agent.pool and agent.models.* are left empty: one model for every phase.
notes.second_provider: No OPENAI/GEMINI key is supplied (concept figures stay in deterministic export mode).
notes.time: No global wall-clock or token cap exists upstream; the runner enforces time_limit_hours. Native caps used: idea cycles=3, per-phase timeouts from [systems.agentic-scientist].
notes.network: Sibling agent containers run on the shield's internal network; the agents keep their CLI WebFetch/Bash network, which go through the shield. Provider hosts are only tunnelled by the shield.
notes.search: Provider server-side web search is switched off in every sibling by the agent CLIs' own system settings, bind-mounted read-only by the docker shim: Claude Code /etc/claude-code/managed-settings.json (permissions.deny WebSearch), Codex /etc/codex/config.toml (web_search="disabled") and /etc/codex/requirements.toml (allowed_web_search_modes=["disabled"]). Upstream's own Semantic Scholar client goes through the shield.
notes.key_exposure: The provider key is in the environment of the agent containers (upstream env-file mechanism) and therefore visible to commands the agent runs. Claude Code's CLAUDE_CODE_SUBPROCESS_ENV_SCRUB=1 was tried and aborts: it needs bubblewrap, which the unmodified upstream agent image lacks.
notes.gpu: gpus=1 is wired (container.gpu_count, harness GPU evaluation) but was not exercised.
notes.docker_socket: The orchestrator container has the host docker socket (root-equivalent on the host).

Literature search in stage 4 uses ['openalex', 'semantic_scholar'] through ARC's own clients behind the shield proxy; stages 8, 17, 22 and 23 (novelty, citation verification) always also query arXiv, CrossRef and DataCite; the shield date-bounds those API calls like the others (a late DOI answers 403).

notes.model: claude-opus-5-5 through the Anthropic Messages API (llm.provider=anthropic), no fallback models, reviewer model = same model. Requests carry model, messages and max_tokens only (no tools, no thinking parameter); ARC's per-stage temperature is not sent because the model rejects it, so the API default applies.
notes.agent: ARC is not a tool-using coding agent: its 23-stage pipeline, its own code agent and its reviewers are prompt chains over plain chat completions. conditions.agent=claude means only that the provider is Anthropic; Claude Code is not involved. Generated experiments run as a plain subprocess in the container.
notes.effort: ARC has no effort setting; usage-log.patch sends output_config.effort='high' with every request. Haiku 5.5 thinks by default and ARC's per-stage max_tokens (for example 4096) is shared with the thinking tokens, so long outputs can still be cut short.
notes.venue: Not chosen by the system: export.target_conference=iclr_2026 comes from [systems.autoresearchclaw].
notes.tokens: ARC records no usage. A logging-only patch (usage-log.patch) appends each Messages API `usage` block to anthropic-usage.jsonl; cost is not computed. The same patch carries the RWE_OMIT_TEMPERATURE and RWE_EFFORT switches.
notes.time: No global wall-clock or budget cap in ARC; only the runner's limit applies. Per experiment run 3600 s, refinement iterations 10, repair cycles 3.
notes.input: Chinese pack text goes verbatim (candidate files concatenated, with <!-- file --> markers) into prompts.extra_prompts of 18 stages. ARC takes one topic string and checks generated code against it, so research.topic is the candidate TASK.md verbatim with whitespace collapsed. Literature queries come from the stage-3 model plan; ARC's ASCII keyword splitter and its whitespace-based query expansion yield a few useless queries from the Chinese text. Starter papers are guidance text only: ARC cannot ingest seed papers.
notes.search: Web search, crawling, GitHub, HF Hub, Gemini and OpenCode are off. Literature search in stage 4 uses ['openalex', 'semantic_scholar'] through ARC's own clients behind the shield proxy; stages 8, 17, 22 and 23 (novelty, citation verification) always also query arXiv, CrossRef and DataCite; the shield date-bounds those API calls like the others (a late DOI answers 403).
notes.server_side_search: Not reachable: every request to api.anthropic.com is built in researchclaw/llm/anthropic_adapter.py:136-148 and carries only model, messages, max_tokens, optional temperature, output_config.effort and system, never a tools or web_search field; the OpenAI-compatible client (OpenRouter :online / plugins) is not used (llm.provider=anthropic), web_search.enabled=false, Gemini is only used by the disabled figure_agent.nano_banana. Provider hosts are only tunnelled by the shield, so such a path would be invisible to the audit.
notes.secrets: Generated experiment code inherits the container environment, including the API keys (ARC offers no switch to scrub it).
notes.profile: project.profile=ml_generic is fixed for all tasks; research.domains is left empty because the literature screen rejects papers outside the stated domain (a theory task failed with domains=[machine-learning]).

tools.permissions: think_tool, deepagents built-ins, EvoSkills skills and an execute shell; skill_manager not registered; no search tool

preinstalled.zh: 上游锁定依赖（uv sync --frozen）加兼容补丁 compat.patch；TeX Live（含 fonts-extra、latexmk）；给 agent 用的研究 Python 环境 /opt/research
preinstalled.en: upstream's locked dependencies (uv sync --frozen) plus compat.patch; TeX Live (with fonts-extra and latexmk); a research Python environment for the agent in /opt/research

notes.agent: No external coding agent: EvoScientist runs its own in-process planner/research/code/debug/writing sub-agents (LangChain deepagents) on the one configured model. conditions.agent only selects the provider; Claude Code and Codex are not used.
notes.model: Main agent, sub-agents and EvoScientist's auxiliary calls (tool selector, memory workers, summariser, graders) all use the configured model; auxiliary_model and model_fallbacks are empty.
notes.effort: Upstream hard-wires effort=max and max_tokens=128000 for Anthropic models. compat.patch makes the effort come from EVOSCIENTIST_REASONING_EFFORT (= conditions.effort); max_tokens stays 128000 (a cap, not a cost driver). Adaptive thinking (display=summarized) is upstream and not switchable.
notes.paper: The core writes a Markdown report (final_report.md); the EvoSkills paper-writing skill gives a generic LaTeX `article` skeleton with no ICML/ICLR/NeurIPS style and no compile step. The image has TeX Live (latexmk, fonts-extra) but no venue style files; the task asks for an official template, so a venue-formatted PDF depends on the agent obtaining the style through the shield. No extra pipeline stage was added; absent items are listed in result.missing.
notes.tools: skill_manager (git clone of any repository as a skill) is not registered (compat.patch); the Tavily key is not set so tavily_search does not exist; LANGGRAPH_CLI_NO_ANALYTICS=1; EvoSkills is baked in at its pinned commit. The execute shell and the EvoSkills paper-navigator scripts reach the world only through the shield; S2_DATE_CUTOFF is not set (the shield bounds dates).
notes.server_side_search: Not reachable: EvoScientist binds no provider-side search tool to any model (its only tools are think_tool, tavily_search when TAVILY_API_KEY is set, MCP tools from mcp.yaml, deepagents built-ins and skills; EvoScientist/EvoScientist.py:671-672 and 754-755 at the pin; the one bind_tools call is the tool selector's own output schema, middleware/tool_selector.py:166). TAVILY_API_KEY is not passed and the image has no mcp.yaml, so no search tool exists. Anthropic/OpenAI hosts are only tunnelled by the shield, so a provider-side search would be invisible to the audit.
notes.credentials: The provider key is in the process environment and EvoScientist's execute shell inherits the environment (upstream has no switch); the key is therefore visible to the agent's shell. It is a run-scoped copy and is not logged by this adapter.
notes.memory: A fresh data dir per run (baked skills, empty memory). Memory workers, skill synthesis and the scheduler stay at upstream defaults, so their LLM calls count in the usage log.
notes.limits: async sub-agents off (README advice for scripted runs); recursion_limit=1000000; model retry wait in auto-mode 1800 s (time without progress counts as wall time); execute timeout 300 s per command. No token or cost budget exists.

means.zh: 没有研究框架，把任务包直接交给一个 coding agent CLI（Claude Code 记作 CC，Codex 记作 CX）无头运行一次。
means.en: No research framework: the task package goes straight to one coding-agent CLI (CC for Claude Code, CX for Codex), run once headless.

means.zh: 形如“系统简写-模型简写”：RW = ResearchWorld，CC = Claude Code 单 agent，CX = Codex 单 agent，AS = The Agentic Scientist，ARC = AutoResearchClaw，EVO = EvoScientist；opus、sonnet、astra、sol 是模型，mixed 表示各岗位用不同 agent。看板总是同时给出全称。
means.en: Written system-model: RW = ResearchWorld, CC = Claude Code alone, CX = Codex alone, AS = The Agentic Scientist, ARC = AutoResearchClaw, EVO = EvoScientist; opus, sonnet, astra and sol are models, mixed means different agents per role. The dashboard always shows the full name as well.

means.en: Writing a paper from research materials (200 CVPR/ICLR 2025 papers); official metrics include citation F1.

means.zh: 重建论文并评测表达和幻觉（51 篇），由 LLM 判官按 rubric 打分。
means.en: Reconstructing papers and judging presentation and hallucination (51 papers), scored by an LLM judge with a rubric.

means.zh: 本项目自己的任务：给系统一个研究问题和材料，要它独立做完研究并交一篇论文和代码；原论文在评测侧。
means.en: This project's own tasks: the system gets a research question and materials and must do the research alone, delivering a paper and code; the original paper is on the evaluator side.

means.zh: 第三方发布的任务集和评分方法；我们按它的官方设置运行其中的条目。
means.en: A third-party task set with its scoring; we run its items with the official setup.

means.zh: benchmark 里的一道题（一个任务）。
means.en: One task of a benchmark.

means.zh: 一次评测用的一组任务（src/tasks/batches/）。
means.en: The set of tasks one evaluation uses (src/tasks/batches/).

means.zh: 被测系统和它的 agent、provider、模型、推理强度的一种组合（src/experiments/conditions.yaml，Issue 31）。
means.en: One combination of a system with its agent, provider, model and reasoning effort (src/experiments/conditions.yaml, Issue 31).

means.zh: 与 ResearchWorld 对比的四个系统（代码和 Docker 对象里叫 B1）：单 coding agent、The Agentic Scientist、AutoResearchClaw、EvoScientist。
means.en: The four systems compared with ResearchWorld (called B1 in code and Docker objects): the single coding agent, The Agentic Scientist, AutoResearchClaw and EvoScientist.

means.zh: 按 E2E 任务的 rubric 逐项打分（0–100）的 LLM 判官，多次采样。
means.en: An LLM judge that scores an E2E task's rubric item by item (0-100), with several samples.

means.zh: Sakana AI Scientist 的自动审稿（1–10 分），用论文自己的设置。
means.en: Sakana AI Scientist's automatic review (1-10), with the paper's own settings.

means.zh: paperreview.ai 的审稿（手工提交，看板解析保存的审稿页）。
means.en: paperreview.ai's review (submitted by hand; the saved review page is parsed).

means.zh: PaperWritingBench 的官方指标（引用 F1 等）。
means.en: PaperWritingBench's official metrics (citation F1 and more).

means.zh: ScienceAgentBench 的官方评测程序（SR、VER、CBS）。
means.en: ScienceAgentBench's official evaluation (SR, VER, CBS).

means.zh: 每个任务的官方验证程序，reward 为 0 或 1。
means.en: Each task's official verifier; the reward is 0 or 1.

means.zh: 按目标论文检查清单加权打分（0–100）的官方 LLM 判官。
means.en: The official LLM judge, a weighted score against the target study's checklist (0-100).

means.zh: PaperWrite-Bench 的官方 rubric 评分（1–5）和引用、幻觉指标。
means.en: PaperWrite-Bench's official rubric score (1-5) with citation and hallucination metrics.

means.zh: 检查论文里的实证陈述有没有问题的附加 LLM 判官（越低越好）。
means.en: An additional LLM judge that checks the paper's empirical claims (lower is better).

means.zh: ScienceAgentBench：程序输出达到任务成功标准的比例。
means.en: ScienceAgentBench: the share of programs whose output meets the task's success criterion.

means.zh: ScienceAgentBench：程序能无错运行并产生输出的比例。
means.en: ScienceAgentBench: the share of programs that run without error and produce output.

means.zh: ScienceAgentBench：生成程序与参考程序的 CodeBERT 相似度。
means.en: ScienceAgentBench: CodeBERT similarity between the generated and the reference program.

means.zh: 把两篇论文放在一起由判官比较优劣的评测方式。
means.en: A judge compares two papers placed side by side.

means.zh: 论文引用与参考引用匹配的 F1。
means.en: F1 of the paper's citations against the reference citations.

means.zh: PaperWrite-Bench：判官找到的严重事实错误条数。
means.en: PaperWrite-Bench: the number of major factual errors the judge found.

means.zh: PaperWritingBench：判官对相关工作部分的总评。
means.en: PaperWritingBench: the judge's overall rating of the related-work section.

means.zh: PaperWritingBench：AgentReview 审稿器对整篇论文的总评。
means.en: PaperWritingBench: the AgentReview reviewer's overall rating of the whole paper.

name.zh: SxS 论文质量（对原论文）

means.zh: PaperWritingBench：判官把系统的论文与原论文并排比较论文质量，结果是 win、tie 或 loss（系统一方）。
means.en: PaperWritingBench: the judge compares the system's paper with the original side by side on paper quality; win, tie or loss for the system.

name.zh: SxS 文献综述（对原论文）

means.zh: PaperWritingBench：判官把系统与原论文的相关工作部分并排比较，结果是 win、tie 或 loss（系统一方）。
means.en: PaperWritingBench: the judge compares the related-work sections of the system's paper and the original side by side; win, tie or loss for the system.

name.zh: 有问题陈述比例（Gemini 判官）

means.zh: 忠实度判官用 Gemini 时，有问题的实证陈述占比。
means.en: With the Gemini judge, the share of empirical claims with a problem.

means.zh: Terminal-Bench-Science 验证程序给出的 0 或 1。
means.en: 0 or 1 from the Terminal-Bench-Science verifier.

means.zh: 评测侧按原论文写的逐项评分标准。
means.en: The item-by-item scoring standard written from the original paper on the evaluator side.

means.zh: 运行记录在跑，进程（或系统自己的驱动）还活着。
means.en: The run is recorded as running and its process (or the system's own driver) is alive.

means.zh: 命令已返回，系统自己的驱动（例如 HuTian 的服务）还在跑。
means.en: The command has returned; the system's own driver (for example HuTian's service) still runs.

name.zh: 记录在跑但进程已不在

means.zh: 记录还是 running，但记录的进程已经不在；需要用 runs 命令收尾。
means.en: The record still says running but its process is gone; the runs command closes it.

means.zh: 系统正常结束并交付。
means.en: The system ended normally and delivered.

means.zh: 系统出错结束。
means.en: The system ended with an error.

means.zh: 用完了时间、预算或回合上限。
means.en: It used up its time, budget or turn limit.

means.zh: 被 stop 命令停止。
means.en: Stopped by the stop command.

means.zh: 运行没能开始（例如预检失败）。
means.en: The run could not start (for example a failed preflight).

means.zh: 进程消失且没有结果，记录被收尾为 lost。
means.en: The process disappeared without a result; the record was closed as lost.

means.zh: world 的研究预算用完了：计费回合的模型时间（max_model_seconds）或回合数上限（max_executions）；不是墙钟时间上限（HuTian DEV.md 11.12）。
means.en: The world used up its research budget: the model time of billed turns (max_model_seconds) or the turn cap (max_executions); not the wall-clock limit (HuTian DEV.md 11.12).

means.zh: 到了这次驱动的墙钟截止时间（--deadline-sec 与 world 的 total_seconds 取早者）。
means.en: The drive reached its wall-clock deadline (the earlier of --deadline-sec and the world's total_seconds).

means.zh: 剩下的墙钟少于开一个回合需要的秒数（start_seconds），驱动停下（HuTian DEV.md 11.12）。
means.en: The wall clock left was below what a new turn needs (start_seconds), so the driver stopped (HuTian DEV.md 11.12).

means.zh: 这次驱动用完了 --max-executions 给的执行次数。
means.en: The drive used up the executions --max-executions allowed.

means.zh: 驱动看到 world 一直空闲而停下。
means.en: The driver stopped because the world stayed idle.

means.zh: 这一格还没有运行。
means.en: This cell has no run yet.

means.zh: 维护者定为不跑的系统 × benchmark 组合（conditions.yaml 的 plan.unsupported），原因写在格子里。
means.en: A system × benchmark combination the maintainer decided not to run (plan.unsupported in conditions.yaml); the cell gives the reason.

means.zh: 这一格最近一次运行完成。
means.en: The latest run of this cell completed.

means.zh: 有完成或失败的格子，但没有全部完成。
means.en: Some cells are done or failed, not all are done.

means.zh: 维护者还没有决定（条件的设置，或哪些格子要跑）。
means.en: Not decided by the maintainer yet (a condition's setting, or which cells run).

means.zh: 正式的评测运行；只有它进入矩阵和评测汇总。
means.en: A formal evaluation run; only these count in the matrix and the evaluation summaries.

means.zh: 检查系统、评测或设置是否可用的运行，不算评测结果。
means.en: A run that checks a system, an evaluator or a setting; not an evaluation result.

means.zh: 在冒烟任务 s00 上用最小设置证明流程走通，不代表质量。
means.en: Proves the path works on the smoke task s00 with the smallest settings; says nothing about quality.

means.zh: 评测系统自己的运行。
means.en: An evaluator's own run.

means.zh: 审稿人对论文的运行。
means.en: A reviewer's run on a paper.

means.zh: 运行只能经代理上网：屏蔽表里的地址（原论文、看板等）被拦截，文献检索按时间截止过滤。
means.en: A run reaches the network only through a proxy: addresses on the blocklist (the original paper, the dashboard and more) are blocked, and literature search is cut off at the time cutoff.

means.zh: 联网屏蔽的正式模式：拦截屏蔽表，按时间截止过滤检索。
means.en: The formal shield mode: the blocklist is enforced and search is date-bounded.

name.zh: 全部经屏蔽代理（HuTian 的强制上游代理）
name.en: Everything through the shield proxy (HuTian's mandatory upstream proxy)

means.zh: ResearchWorld 的屏蔽模式（HuTian v4.2.0 起）：每个岗位的每个请求都经本次运行的屏蔽代理，规则与其他系统相同（URL、关键词、id、日期），代理记下每个完整 URL；没有直连出口，服务商端检索和远端工具关闭。E2E 和 benchmark 题相同。
means.en: ResearchWorld's shield mode (from HuTian v4.2.0): every request of every role goes through the run's shield proxy, with the same rules as the other systems (URL, keyword, id, date), and the proxy logs each full URL; there is no direct way out, and server-side search and remote tools are off. The same for E2E tasks and benchmark items.

name.zh: 名单主机经代理（早期屏蔽模式）
name.en: Listed hosts through the proxy (earlier shield mode)

means.zh: ResearchWorld 在 HuTian v4.1.0 下的屏蔽模式（#73 之前的运行）：屏蔽表涉及的主机经同一个代理、按同样规则拦截和过滤；其余主机走 HuTian 的开放网络，屏蔽表的关键词和 id 在那里只做事后审计。
means.en: ResearchWorld's shield mode under HuTian v4.1.0 (runs before #73): the hosts the blocklist touches go through the same proxy with the same rules; other hosts go over HuTian's open network, where the blocklist's keywords and ids are only audited afterwards.

means.zh: 这一题的官方 agent 没有网页访问：屏蔽只放行模型供应商，其余请求一律拒绝（规则 offline），受控检索也拒绝；ResearchWorld 的 world 不设网络资源。
means.en: The item's official agents have no web access: the shield lets only the model provider through and refuses every other request (rule offline), search included; a ResearchWorld world gets no network resource.

name.zh: 按主机拒绝（ResearchWorld 早期的 benchmark 题）
name.en: Hosts denied (ResearchWorld on a benchmark item

means.zh: 在 HuTian v4.1.0 下（#73 之前的运行），ResearchWorld 跑 benchmark 题时走 HuTian 的开放网络，题目屏蔽表里能整站拒绝的主机写进网络资源的 deny 列表；HuTian 的网关只看主机，共享站点上的 URL、关键词和 id 只做事后审计。
means.en: Under HuTian v4.1.0 (runs before #73), ResearchWorld on a benchmark item used HuTian's open network, with the hosts of the item's blocklist that can be refused whole on the network resource's deny list; HuTian's gateway sees hosts only, so URLs on shared hosts, keywords and ids were only audited afterwards.

name.zh: 在官方任务镜像里工作
name.en: Works in the official task image

means.zh: 基准有自己的 agent 环境镜像（Terminal-Bench-Science）时，系统在以它为底构建的镜像里工作，文件就在任务给的位置。
means.en: When a benchmark has its own agent environment image (Terminal-Bench-Science), the system works in an image built on it, with the files where the task put them.

means.zh: 系统不能在官方任务镜像里工作：任务镜像里的文件复制到它的工作目录。
means.en: The system cannot work inside the official task image: the image's files are copied into its working directory.

name.zh: 系统自己的镜像加装任务软件
name.en: The system's own image with the task's software

means.zh: 系统不能在官方任务镜像里工作：在它自己的镜像上装任务的系统软件包和独立的 /opt/task-env Python（task_software.yaml），文件复制到工作目录。
means.en: The system cannot work inside the official task image: the task's system packages and a separate /opt/task-env Python (task_software.yaml) are installed on its own image, and the files are copied into its working directory.

name.en: researchworld run (the entry for E2E tasks)

means.zh: E2E 任务用 HuTian 的 run 建 world、由 HuTian 自己的服务驱动，用全部 9 个岗位，可以断点续跑。
means.en: An E2E task: HuTian's run makes the world and HuTian's own service drives it, with all 9 roles; it can resume after a restart.

name.en: researchworld agent (the entry for benchmark items)

means.zh: benchmark 题用 HuTian 给外部评测的入口 agent：固定提示和输入，交付文件齐全才结束；岗位按 HuTian 对该 benchmark 的官方设置。
means.en: A benchmark item: HuTian's entry for external harnesses, agent; it fixes the prompt and inputs and ends only with the required files; the roles follow HuTian's official setting for that benchmark.

means.zh: 交付由检查程序运行或读取的文件。
means.en: Files that a checker runs or reads.

means.zh: 交付一份分析报告及其代码和产出。
means.en: An analysis delivered with its code, outputs and report.

means.zh: 由给定材料写一篇论文。
means.en: A paper written from supplied material.

means.zh: 一次运行禁止访问的地址和关键词（运行目录的 blocklist.json）。
means.en: Addresses and keywords a run may not reach (blocklist.json in the run directory).

means.zh: E2E 任务原论文最早公开的日期；系统能检索到的内容须早于它。它在评测侧。
means.en: The earliest public date of an E2E task's original paper; what a system can find must be older. It is on the evaluator side.

means.zh: 交给被测系统的任务材料（candidate/），全文公开。
means.en: The task materials given to the system (candidate/), public in full.

means.zh: 只给评测用、不交给被测系统的材料：原论文、rubric、泄露检查、参考答案和评分程序。看板直接显示；被测系统运行时访问不到看板（看板地址在每次运行的屏蔽表里）。
means.en: Materials for evaluation only, never given to the system: the original paper, rubric, leakage check, reference solution and scoring code. The dashboard shows them; a system under test cannot reach the dashboard (its address is on every run's blocklist).

means.zh: ResearchWorld 的一次研究：一组岗位、它们之间的协作关系、预算和共享的代码仓库。
means.en: One piece of research in ResearchWorld: a set of roles, how they work together, a budget and shared repositories.

means.zh: world 里的一个职位（例如写论文、做实验、内部审稿），由一个 agent 担任。E2E 任务用全部 9 个岗位；benchmark 题目按 HuTian 官方 benchmark 设置选岗位（见 ResearchWorld README“benchmark 题目”）。
means.en: A position in a world (for example writing the paper, running experiments, internal review), held by one agent. E2E tasks use all 9 roles; a benchmark item takes the roles of HuTian's own benchmark settings (see "Benchmark items" in the ResearchWorld README).

means.zh: HuTian 用它经 ACP（Agent Client Protocol）驱动各岗位的 agent。
means.en: HuTian drives each role's agent with it over ACP (Agent Client Protocol).

means.zh: 给 agent 接工具的协议；基线用它提供受控的文献和网页检索。
means.en: A protocol that gives an agent tools; the baselines get the controlled literature and web search through it.

means.zh: 从开始到结束实际经过的时间。
means.en: The real time from start to end.

means.zh: 花在模型请求上的秒数，取自系统自己的日志（ResearchWorld 的 receipt、Claude Code 的 duration_api_ms、AutoResearchClaw 和 EvoScientist 每次请求的耗时）；Codex 不记录，写明原因。
means.en: Seconds spent on model requests, from the system's own logs (ResearchWorld's receipts, Claude Code's duration_api_ms, AutoResearchClaw's and EvoScientist's per-request times); Codex does not record it, and the run says so.

means.zh: 向模型服务商发出的请求次数；各系统"回合"的口径不同，跨系统比较用它。
means.en: The number of requests sent to the model provider; systems count turns differently, so compare this across systems.

means.zh: 订阅登录的运行按 prices.toml 价目表把 token 折成的美元数，只作比较，不是实际花费，不计入费用合计。
means.en: A subscription run's tokens at the prices.toml list prices: for comparison only, never a charge and never added to the cost totals.

means.zh: 输入、输出、缓存读、缓存写四类 token。
means.en: Input, output, cache-read and cache-write tokens.

means.zh: 费用一律由 token 乘 prices.toml 的价目表重算，不用系统自报的费用。
means.en: Cost is always recomputed from tokens with the prices.toml list, never taken from the system's own report.

means.zh: 经订阅（Claude Max、ChatGPT）运行，没有按量费用，只列 token。
means.en: Runs on a subscription (Claude Max, ChatGPT): no per-token charge, only tokens are listed.

means.zh: 运行进程每 30 秒写一次的存活记录。
means.en: The liveness record the run process writes every 30 seconds.

means.zh: 运行结束后检查它有没有访问屏蔽表里的来源、论文有没有用到它们；不是对研究质量的评分。
means.en: After a run, checks whether it reached blocklisted sources and whether its paper used them; not a score of research quality.

means.zh: 论文按哪个会议的格式写（ICML、ICLR、NeurIPS 等）。
means.en: Which conference format the paper follows (ICML, ICLR, NeurIPS and others).

means.zh: 维护者的多 agent 平台，ResearchWorld 是其中的研究领域。
means.en: The maintainer's multi-agent platform; ResearchWorld is its research domain.

means.zh: ResearchWorld：E2E 任务用全部 9 个岗位；benchmark 题目按 HuTian 官方 benchmark 设置选岗位；所有岗位同一模型；provider —，推理强度 high。
means.en: ResearchWorld: all 9 roles for E2E tasks; benchmark items take the roles of HuTian's own benchmark settings; the same model in every role; provider —, reasoning effort high.

means.zh: ResearchWorld：E2E 任务用全部 9 个岗位；benchmark 题目按 HuTian 官方 benchmark 设置选岗位；所有岗位同一模型；provider —，推理强度 high。
means.en: ResearchWorld: all 9 roles for E2E tasks; benchmark items take the roles of HuTian's own benchmark settings; the same model in every role; provider —, reasoning effort high.

name.zh: ResearchWorld：Antigravity（Gemini） + Gemini 4 Argon（high）、Claude Code + Claude Opus 5.5、Codex CLI + GPT-6.1 Sol
name.en: ResearchWorld: Antigravity (Gemini) + Gemini 4 Argon (high), Claude Code + Claude Opus 5.5, Codex CLI + GPT-6.1 Sol

means.zh: ResearchWorld，岗位混用三种 agent，各取所长：写作岗位用 Gemini（agy），实验和图表用 Claude Code，审稿内外分开（Codex 和 Claude Code）；provider —，推理强度 按岗位。
means.en: ResearchWorld, roles mixing three agents by strength: Gemini (agy) in the writing roles, Claude Code for experiments and figures, internal and external review by different agents (Codex and Claude Code); provider —, reasoning effort per role.

means.zh: coding agent（Claude Code）；provider anthropic，推理强度 high。
means.en: Single coding agent (Claude Code); provider anthropic, reasoning effort high.

means.zh: coding agent（Claude Code）；provider anthropic，推理强度 high。
means.en: Single coding agent (Claude Code); provider anthropic, reasoning effort high.

means.zh: coding agent（Codex，经 codex-api）；provider openai，推理强度 high。
means.en: Single coding agent (Codex, through codex-api); provider openai, reasoning effort high.

means.zh: coding agent（Codex，经 codex-api）；provider openai，推理强度 high。
means.en: Single coding agent (Codex, through codex-api); provider openai, reasoning effort high.

name.zh: The Agentic Scientist：Claude Code + Claude Opus 5.5
name.en: The Agentic Scientist: Claude Code + Claude Opus 5.5

means.zh: The Agentic Scientist；provider anthropic，推理强度 high。
means.en: The Agentic Scientist; provider anthropic, reasoning effort high.

name.zh: The Agentic Scientist：Claude Code + Claude Sonnet 5.5
name.en: The Agentic Scientist: Claude Code + Claude Sonnet 5.5

means.zh: The Agentic Scientist；provider anthropic，推理强度 high。
means.en: The Agentic Scientist; provider anthropic, reasoning effort high.

means.en: AutoResearchClaw; provider anthropic, reasoning effort high.

means.en: AutoResearchClaw; provider anthropic, reasoning effort high.

means.en: EvoScientist; provider anthropic, reasoning effort high.

scienceagentbench/92|AS-opus.reason: 不在官方提示的交付路径交付：模型 agent 在兄弟容器里、以上游自己的运行目录为 /workspace 工作，看不到交给系统的起始文件和交付路径；范式是起草评测器后优化一个标量、再写论文。证据：TBS symbolic-regression 的 regressor.py 与起始文件逐字节相同；SAB 92 冒烟里兄弟容器因 /workspace 重复挂载起不来（已修，修后交付仍不在交付路径）。维护者 2026-10-28 决定不花钱真跑（#77 方案 B）。
scienceagentbench/92|AS-opus.reason_en: Does not deliver at the paths the official prompt names: the model agents work in sibling containers with upstream's own run directory as /workspace and never see the starting files or the deliverable paths; the paradigm drafts an evaluator, optimises a scalar and writes a paper. Evidence: in TBS symbolic-regression regressor.py stayed byte-identical to the starting file; in the SAB 92 smoke run the siblings did not start because of a duplicate /workspace mount (fixed; deliverables still not at the paths). Maintainer, 2026-10-28: not run (#77, option B).

scienceagentbench/92|ARC-opus.reason: 没有能用工具的 agent，是 23 段提示链：产出写在自己的 deliverables 目录，不在官方提示的交付路径；装包被关（PIP_NO_INDEX）；离线题的文献检索全部被拒、空 shortlist 会暂停。证据：TBS symbolic-regression 起始文件未改；SAB 92 冒烟 23 段跑完、交付缺失。维护者 2026-10-28 决定不花钱真跑（#77 方案 B）。
scienceagentbench/92|ARC-opus.reason_en: No tool-using agent, a 23-stage prompt chain: it writes into its own deliverables directory, not at the paths the official prompt names; package installs are off (PIP_NO_INDEX); for an offline item every literature search is refused and an empty shortlist pauses it. Evidence: TBS symbolic-regression starting file unchanged; the SAB 92 smoke run finished all 23 stages with the deliverable missing. Maintainer, 2026-10-28: not run (#77, option B).

subset.rule: 过滤基准规则（低成本，或完整运行在 8 小时内，优先 CPU）。具体判据（本 manifest 自定，可复核）： 任务 data/ 体积 <=30 MB，且在 36 个公开 leaderboard 条目中观察到的单次最长墙钟 <=480 分钟； 结果为 32/40 个任务，CPU 即可（官方无 GPU 要求）。 被排除 8 个：Chemistry_003（最长 726 min）、Information_001（492 min）、Information_003（476 min, 32.7 MB）、 Neuroscience_002（421 min, 97 MB）、Math_002（360 min, 104 MB, 2510 个文件）、Energy_000（352 min, 61.6 MB）、 Earth_002（136 MB）、Earth_003（54.7 MB）。 注意：此处以 agent 观察时长为依据，不是 judge 或 oracle 的运行时长；真实时长取决于我们的 agent。

licence.data: 仓库随任务提交的数据/夹具 (总计约 1.1 GiB 任务目录, 见 subset.full_task_list task_dir_kb) 与仓库同属 Apache-2.0 的默认假设; 个别任务可能自带第三方数据。

subset.rule: CPU 优先、低成本、全量可在 8h 内跑完 (针对 'terminal-bench-science' 过滤基准)。 基于 task.toml 的确定性过滤: gpus=0 且 cpus<=4 且 memory_mb<=8192 且 storage_mb<=10240 且 verifier.timeout_sec<=1800 且 任务目录<=10 MiB 且 无 docker-compose sidecar 且 Dockerfile 无 cuda/torch。 保持 8h 墙钟: 每个任务 agent timeout 上限 8h, 27 个容器并发 (合计 78 vCPU / 142 GiB RAM / 243 GiB 磁盘上限) 时整体墙钟 <= 8h + 构建/验证 (verifier 合计上限 4.0h, 并行时不叠加)。 若串行则上限 216 agent-hours, 不满足 8h, 故需并发。
